text:
alex: Heads up — after pushing driver 550.x to the us-west GPU pool, ~6 nodes failed to become Ready. Stuck during early boot at 'Starting NVIDIA modules', systemd waiting on /dev/nvidia0. DKMS shows build failures and modprobe times out. cc @marta

marta: ouch. which kernel are those nodes on? 6.1 or 6.4?

alex: ubuntu-22.04 images with kernel 6.1.0-1027-gke. CI built the module fine but prod dkms rebuild fails with symbol mismatches. quick dmesg snip below:

alex: ```
[    8.123456] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.
[    8.124000] nvidia: module license 'NVIDIA' taints kernel.
[    8.125000] nvidia: unknown symbol nvidia_pci_probe (err -2)
[    8.125500] nvidia: Failed to initialize NVML
[   30.000000] systemd[1]: Timed out waiting for device /dev/nvidia0.
```

ryan: can you paste output of `dkms status` and `uname -a` from one affected node? Also check `modinfo nvidia` if available.

alex: dkms status: `nvidia, 550: installed but not built for 6.1.0-1027-gke`
modprobe timeout = 120s on boot. systemd logs show `modprobe returned exit-code 1` then timeout.

marta: my hunch: kernel ABI or gcc mismatch. CI uses gcc 12; prod nodes use 13 builder? Also upstream had a symbol rename in the kernel headers recently. If DKMS builds against headers with that rename, the resulting .ko won't match the running kernel.

sre-jen: @alex drain those nodes and open incident. I'll take lead on remediation. Add node names here.

alex: nodes: node-uw2-gpu-117, node-uw2-gpu-118, node-uw2-gpu-121 (plus 3 preemptible ephemeral nodes)

sre-jen: trying a manual `dkms remove -m nvidia -v 550 --all` then `dkms add` + `dkms build` on node-117. If modprobe is failing early at boot we may need to boot with `systemd.unit=multi-user.target` or `nomodeset` to finish repair.

ryan: reproduced locally with kernel 6.4 + CONFIG_PREEMPT_RT disabled; DKMS built but `modinfo` showed unresolved symbol `nvidia_pci_probe` — looks like a renamed export. There's an NVIDIA vendor patch floating to adapt to the rename. I'm linking it.

ryan: https://patches.nvidia/example/rename-export-550-fix

alex: rolling back the staging rollout for 550 in us-west to 535. Holding further rollouts in eu-west until we verify.

infra-ci-bot: rollback job initiated for us-west-gpu-pool by deploy-system — target: revert 3 nodes to driver 535.x (job id: rollback-1779991111)

marta: :thumbsup: also saw early NCCL errors on one of the nodes before it died — `NCCL WARN Allreduce failed` and nv_peer_mem complaining. Could be related to partial module load. Let's watch perf/clique.

sre-jen: updated incident doc: https://our-incidents/INC-2026-197. Added steps: drain, manual dkms remove/add, try rebuild with same gcc as kernel build, fallback to rollback if unavailable.

alex: manual rebuild on node-117 failed — symbols still unresolved. I'm collecting `modpost.log` and full `dkms` output to attach to the ticket.

ryan: second option is to apply the small compatibility shim in DKMS patches (rename alias) — patch exists but needs QA. If we can confirm kernel header versions across fleet we can build a single signed package instead of per-node DKMS.

infra-ci-bot: rollback completed on nodes node-uw2-gpu-117,node-uw2-gpu-118,node-uw2-gpu-121 at 1779991140 (rollback-1779991111)

alex: verified nodes returned to Ready and schedulable. NCCL errors cleared on checks. Marking this thread resolved for now; opening vendor ticket with attached logs.

sre-jen: add preflight step: run `dkms status` on target kernel and `modinfo nvidia` in a dry-run before any driver rollout. Also record toolchain (gcc version) used to build kernel headers.

marta: agreed. pausing all 550 rollouts until we have either vendor fix or a signed package we can push via image update.

alex: noted. I'll add the preflight to the rollout pipeline and link the incident in the rollout PR. Thanks everyone.
